questions.question: Which filter material replaces which material?
When does the trial begin and how many days does it last?
What is the maximum acceptable rejection condition per batch?

answers: fewer than 3 rejected samples per batch

questions.question: What is the exact receipt reference, preserving zero versus letter O?
What is the total paid and payment state?
What storage quota changed, from what value to what value?
Which retry limit and retention period remained unchanged?
What time did the build review move to, and which exact report should be brought?
What pressure and valve state were shown on the instrument panel?
What is the exact calibration key and time until next inspection?

scoring.method: Each evidence requirement needs all literal answers within the same eligible observation of its phase. Every requirement is needed for question success; missing phases or samples are misses.
scoring.identifierPolicy: Exact case-sensitive spelling and punctuation; never equate digit 0 with letter O.
scoring.numericPolicy: Literal numeric spelling and stated units; separate before and after requirements must both pass.
scoring.prosePolicy: Declared literal evidence strings are matched; this is retrieval-evidence coverage, not a model comprehension or paraphrase evaluation.
scoring.noClaim: Question truth is predeclared. No model run, retrieval success, or combined AX/OCR score is implied.
